visual.general_description: Blue-grey monochrome ultrasound sector image of the foetus (with a bluish cast, as if photographed from a monitor) with two yellow numerals, a depth scale on the right and the text "LOGIQ" at the top left.
visual.detailed_description: A fan-shaped blue-grey monochrome B-mode ultrasound image on a dark background. The text "LOGIQ" is printed at the top left and a short grey vertical bar sits at the left edge. A depth scale with yellow tick marks and the printed numerals 0, 5 and 10 runs down the right edge, with a small yellow marker symbol on the depth scale. Below a bright curved near-field band at the top, a wide oblong grey structure with heterogeneous echotexture fills the lower part of the sector. Yellow numeral "1" is printed over the upper part of this structure and yellow numeral "2" over its lower right part. No panel letters, arrows, calipers or measurement boxes are visible.
